title: Pukka Juice 5000+ Lime Twist 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Pukka Juice 5000+ Lime Twist Nic Salt e-liquid brings together the sharp, zesty taste of fresh Limes with the sweet, refreshing twist of Kiwi. The balance of tart citrus and sweet tropical fruit creates an multi-layered and flavourful vape that’s perfect for all-day enjoyment. Crafted with a 50VG/50PG ratio, Pukka Juice 5000+ Nic Salts are designed for use with Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) vape kits and pod systems. These e-liquids deliver smooth throat hits and rapid nicotine absorption, making them a great alternative to traditional tobacco products. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, Lime Twist offers a citrusy vape with a tropical edge. Pukka Juice are a renowned UK vape brand known for their vibrant and original e-liquid flavours. The Pukka Juice 5000+ range offers the intense flavours of disposable vapes in a more convenient, reusable format. Other flavours to try include Pineapple Ice, Blackcurrant Menthol, and Blue Sour Razz.
